breaking.change: Defaults to half instead of full (matching ssrResolution), tracing ambient occlusion at half resolution with a normal- and depth-aware bilateral upsample. QualityPreset.high keeps full.
breaking.fix: Set aoResolution: "full" on PostEffects or RenderSettings.aoResolution: "full" if full-resolution AO is required on medium quality.

breaking.change: Defaults to half instead of full, tracing screen-space GI at half resolution with a normal- and depth-aware bilateral upsample. QualityPreset.high keeps full.
breaking.fix: Set resolution: "full" on GlobalIllumination or RenderSettings.aoResolution: "full" if full-resolution SSGI is required on medium quality.

added.summary: Caps local shadow map layers at 768 texels per side (down from 1024 on QualityPreset.high) to prevent a 768 MiB VRAM cliff when 96 local shadow faces are allocated.
